rows.what the ink shows: Before compact, the abbreviation has a long descending first loop rising into a tall second stroke with a low rightward foot, followed by a separate short terminal upright. The same compact stroke arrangement is visible in the crossed-out occurrence immediately below.

The cancellation runs through the word at letter-body height. A descending hook survives near the left, a small raised middle stroke and dot survive above the bar, and an angled terminal stroke remains at the right; the intervening contours are merged with the strike. A comparison with the two visible compact occurrences farther right does not establish the initial c or the internal letter sequence securely.

Despite the horizontal cancellation, the first stroke descends in a narrow loop below it and rises into the next tall stroke; a small foot and final separate upright remain above the bar. These are the same abbreviation strokes seen immediately above in M0256.

The superscript immediately right of the heavily overwritten first L is a horizontally joined pair of rounded lobes with a central waist, clearly an infinity sign. It is separate from the overwritten capital and is not the single upright of 1.

With the marginal writing rotated clockwise, the first line begins with a large open capital C and a small rounded lower return; successive low connected strokes lead to a distinct short c/t-like rise and a final shallow ion wave. The complete visible sequence supports Correction.

The second marginal line has a short separate first word beginning with a descending p-hook and finishing in a point and horizontal r-tail. The following word starts with a curved s, then a short link and two distinct long p-descenders, followed by compressed small strokes and a final horizontal ion tail: par suppression.

At the left of the line before fermé, the initial f has an upper loop and a long lower loop; the next upright has a small low foot, and the terminal short t has a visible cross-stroke. The four-letter abbreviation is compressed into these joined strokes.

After demi-espaces, the abbreviation begins with a tall f whose loop descends below the line; a rounded open second stroke and a short terminal upright with a rightward cross-stroke precede fermés. Its surviving strokes agree with the other fblt forms on this page.

After qui sont, a tall f turns into a lower loop and rightward arm; the middle low curved strokes carry a clearly separate acute accent, and the word ends in an extended low connected ment stroke. The following de begins separately after a gap.

After forme, a narrow closed upper loop descends well below the baseline; its rising return joins a tall ascender and low rightward hook. A separate small upright with a hooked foot closes the abbreviation. These strokes support fblt.

The deletion starts with a looped, descending stroke compatible with f, then a heavy horizontal cancellation coincides with the letter bodies. A low oval survives near the middle and a few shallow humps and faint uprights survive at the right; they do not distinguish the complete words forme continue.

The deleted operator retains a rounded upper S curve and lower turn followed by a short low horizontal stroke. A hooked downstroke lies to the right beneath the cancellation. Unlike the clear Sup with a separately dotted lower i on the next line, the deleted operator has no separately discriminable dot or complete p bowl; the division of the last stroke between p and index remains uncertain.

The slanting marginal phrase has a very long f descender, a connected low ai stroke with a detached dot, and a short final upright for t. The following word begins with a deep returning g-shaped stroke, then compressed low letter strokes, two detached accent marks, and a curled terminal stroke, supporting général.

In the rotated marginal note the final word has a tall initial f stroke, a small detached rounded o mark, a long compressed connection, a raised crossed or looped t region, and small terminal marks, supporting fonctions. The compact preceding strokes do not let me separate and verify sur les; that portion remains uncertain.

Under the dense crossing-out, the left symbol retains a vertical P stem and upper bowl. A curved parenthesis leads into a narrow loop and long descending f stroke, followed by a separate curved upright at the right for the closing parenthesis.

Below the cancellation there is an initial hooked s, a descending p with a short right shoulder, two shallow curved letter bodies, and a tall t stem meeting the deletion line. The latter part is compressed into a low connected sweep with a final rising and turning t stroke; the visible sequence supports spectralement.

Above the integral, a separate short slanting vertical bar stands to the left of a dense central letter with a tall stem and rightward diagonal arms. A second bowed vertical stroke closes the group at the right. The upper box border crosses the top of the ink, but the two enclosing side strokes and central K remain visible.

notes: All eight assigned marks personally inspected in enlarged source crops; no OCR or text layer used. Source image dimensions 1763 by 1890.

M0266 cancellation and M0267 index retain uncertainty after tight inspection. M0269 narrowed to uncertainty in sur les while fonctions is readable. Independent check requested from root for M0266/M0267 and marginal note.
M0272 candidate body |K| is treated as one mathematical expression with literal vertical bars.

All scan015 mark spans were checked before considering other_errors. A possible separate small word after marginal voir remains only a concern for independent review, not an asserted unmarked correction.
Two additional tight margin crop requests were interrupted before any view result; they are not included in this views list.

reconciliations: Independent report agrees on M0257/M0266/M0267 retained uncertainties and M0268 fait général.
M0269 primary retains fonctions as clear and sur les uncertain; peer keeps the full phrase uncertain. Both descriptions are preserved, with no new positive discriminator requiring another inspection.
M0272 retains literal absolute-value bars in |K|. All assigned rows have concrete ink observations; interrupted crop requests without returned views were not counted or used as evidence.
